mapper.select: SELECT DATE(create_time) AS "date", COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finished, SUM(CASE WHEN task_status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed FROM task_instance WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND create_time >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 day' * #{days} GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY DATE(create_time) ASC
SELECT task_status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS count FROM task_instance WHERE is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY task_status ORDER BY task_status ASC
